content:
Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp
System time of event creation.
FfcLogSourceType
Identifies the type of log from which a log entry is derived.(e.g., Linux Audit logs, Apple Unified logs, etc.)
Values:
LOG_UNDEFINED (0)
LOG_FLATFILE (1)
LOG_LINUXAUDIT (2)
LOG_UTMPRECORD (3)
LOG_APPLESYSTEMLOG (4)
LOG_WINDOWSEVENTLOG (5)
LOG_APPLEUNIFIED (6)
LOG_APPLEAUDIT (7)
LOG_APPLESPOTLIGHT (8)
LOG_WINDOWSWEBLOG (9)
FfcLogOrigin
File path or name of utility from which a log entry was read.
FfcLogConfidenceInterval
Confidence interval of timestamp parsing, in 100ns ticks.
ForensicsText
A unit of forensically intersting text read from a system logor some other text file of interest, such as shell history, ssh config,
startup scripts, etc.
FfcStructuredLogEntry
An entry of structured log data.
ComputerName
Name of the device on which sensor is running.
FfcLogName
Name of event log.
FfcLogEventId
Numerical code to distinguish an event. See https://www.ultimatewindowssecurity.com/securitylog/encyclopedia/default.aspx
[https://www.ultimatewindowssecurity.com/securitylog/encyclopedia/default.aspx]
FfcWindowsLogEventCategory
Numerical category of event, organizing events so Event Viewer can filter them. Each event source can define its own
numbered categories and the text strings to which they are mapped. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-
us/windows/win32/eventlog/event-categories [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/eventlog/event-categories]
FfcWindowsLogEventType
Windows application indicates the event type when it reports an event. Each event must be of a single type.
Values:
SUCCESS (0x0000)
ERROR (0x0001)
WARNING (0x0002)

Field
Description
INFORMATION (0x0004)
AUDIT_SUCCESS (0x0008)
AUDIT_FAILURE (0x0010)
FfcLogFilterTag
Tag indicating which directive in the collector configuration file captured an event. Useful as a quick filter for events.
FfcLogKeyword
64-bit mask defined in an event provider, used to group the event with other similar events (based on the usage of the events).
See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.diagnostics.eventing.reader.standardeventkeywords?
view=netframework-4.8 [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-
us/dotnet/api/system.diagnostics.eventing.reader.standardeventkeywords?view=netframework-4.8]
Values:
NONE (0)
AUDIT_FAILURE (0x0010000000000000)
AUDIT_SUCCESS (0x0020000000000000)
CORRELATION_HINT2 (0x0040000000000000)
EVENTLOG_CLASSIC (0x0080000000000000)
RESPONSE_TIME (0x0001000000000000)
WDI_CONTEXT (0x0002000000000000)
WDI_DIAGNOSTIC (0x0004000000000000)
SQM (0x0008000000000000)
FfcLogRecordNumber
Record identifier within the event log.
